style: The current Sushi Loop native family: warm softly beveled crafted materials, restrained surface wear, local dimensional shading and readable chunky silhouettes. Target a squat damaged honey-wood two-door sideboard with a crooked door and clearly exposed storage cubby.

qualityCriteria.basis: Independent inspection of the actual source snapshot and frozen target-v01, governed by brief.modelingPolicy and capture/footprint constraints.

shapeVolume: The object reads immediately as a squat broad wooden sideboard with a substantial top and enclosed low cabinet body, rather than a shortened open shelf.
Front structure has two distinguishable door regions; at least one door is visibly displaced or broken in an intentional, mechanically plausible relationship to its frame.
The displaced door exposes a clear storage cubby with restrained contents. The door stays visually part of the cabinet; no external loose debris is needed to communicate damage.
Top planks, body frame, door panels and short ground contacts form chunky, separated volumes. Preserve horizontal silhouette and believable depth under the locked elevated source projection.
color: Honey amber wood dominates, with readable light/dark material variation across board edges and recesses.
Metal stays restrained dark neutral gray and contents stay subdued olive/tan. Avoid large black patches, orange glare or noisy high contrast grain.
Required facings keep one coherent palette and exposure.
lightingHighlights: Soft bevel highlights and local dimensional shading make the top, door construction and body depth readable without harsh directional shadow bands.
The storage opening has clear depth and separation while retaining enough tonal information to avoid a flat black hole.
Transparent sprites contain no warm target halo, ground plane, cast ground shadow, emissive rim or view-specific relighting.
materialDetail: Wood feels clean and crafted through softened substantial edges, sparse grain and modest construction variation; damage remains localized and deliberate.
Door frame/panel construction, hinges or knobs where visible, and broad top boards support cabinet identity without tiny clutter.
Surface detail survives downscaling as material richness; it does not become speckle, striping or embossed noise.
artifactFreeReadability: At the phone consumer scale, the broad cabinet mass, door/cubby separation and purposeful damage remain identifiable.

N/E/S/W each present coherent solid furniture with plausible sides/rear, clean silhouettes and consistent material quality. The single target view does not require duplicating its front construction onto hidden faces.
No clipping, coplanar flicker, floating/exposed mesh fragments, abrupt seams, muddy merged edges, clipped alpha or dead dark patches appear in any required view.

technicalLocks: Source camera/projection/matrix, orthographic scale, shift, pixel aspect, frame 896x1344, logical frame 448x672, logical root [224,448], and sourceScale 2 remain locked across all four facings.
Geometry horizontal envelope is x [-1,1], y [-0.5,0.5] for the declared 2x1 footprint; ground contact is z=0 and height does not exceed 1.5.
All final visuals render from editable native geometry/materials in the candidate blend. No target-facing cards, paint-over images or sprite impostors.
No changes to original production library, original source object or unrelated shared assets; backup integrity and resource closure must be evidenced.
requiredEvidence: A sealed immutable candidate packet binding the exact candidate blend, native N/E/S/W PNGs, validation record, four-view-sheet and phone-consumer preview with SHA-256 hashes.
Actual native technical validation of frozen camera/settings/root, frame, model world bounds, z contact, footprint, consistent lights and native geometry/material provenance.
Direct visual inspection of every facing enlarged and at intended size, plus transparent edge appearance on appropriate backgrounds, verified four-view contact sheet and real phone-consumer assembly.
Packet-bound resource closure; no unbound external texture or library dependencies.
excludedTargetFeatures: Lower target viewpoint, alpha-based fitting or per-view camera changes.
Any target door/debris placement that would violate the declared horizontal physical envelope.
evaluationPolicy: Material visible outcomes govern art approval; no universal score cutoff.
Missing packaging or contract proof yields needs_evidence rather than an unnecessary art revision.
No numerical render tolerance is invented from target mismatch or from an edited candidate.

capture.registration: Preserve source camera matrix, ortho/pixel aspect/shift. New physical model fits declared footprint; no alpha fitting or per-view camera changes.
